property_summary: After any fallback call, the contract's balance modulo 10 ether must be 0, because the fallback's payable requirement ensures only multiples of 10 ether can remain after transfers; the buggy version allows any value, breaking this invariant.
change_summary: Delete the require statement for msg.value == 10 ether so fallback can be called with any msg.value, changing when the balance transfer can occur.
